emulated_kernel_racecheck.scope: D128 and interleaved emulator tests including rolling buffers, known answers and invalid-configuration guards

sanitizer_exit_workaround: Direct Python executable, torch.cuda.synchronize and flushed stdout before os._exit(test_status). Both recorded sanitizer runs completed with exit code 0 and final sanitizer summaries.
limitations: Hopper native execution and performance were unavailable locally; hardware-dependent tests were skipped.
The diagnostic emulator defers reading old P/V until after next-tile ExpCast but uses scalar arithmetic instead of concurrent native WGMMA.
Binary checks prove instruction ordering and FP8 instruction presence, not actual overlap duration or native runtime correctness.
H200 native concurrency, CUDA 13 compilation and same-run performance require remote validation.
Ordinary Softmax and unsupported geometries retain earlier cores; interleaved dispatch requires ExpCast and the D128 default geometry.
Shared memory rises from 48 to 56 KiB; register use remains 255 per thread. No residency or latency improvement is claimed before remote measurement.
Static instruction counts include prologue, main loop, key-tail and drain code and do not imply extra matrix operations per tile.
